Also shown is the current tide height and the time to the next tide. You can also select future dates to make it easier to plan a successful beach day or fishing trip. No internet access is required, so if you have no coverage on your device you can still check the tides. All major locations in South Australia are covered, including, Port Adelaide, Brighton, Glenelg, Port Giles, Emu Bay, Port Vincent, Port Lincoln, Althorpe Island, Port Victoria, Reevesby Island, Wedge Island, Port Pirie, Thenevard, Blanche Port, Elliston, Port Eyre, Victor Harbour, Beachport, Kingston, Wallaroo, Port Broughton, Whyalla, Port Augusta, Port Bonython and Red Cliff Point.
